findings.observation: PlatformLanePatternRoles.cs:89 declares PromisesMembershipArchUnitTest.NamespacesOfTheMembersFoundByName as Place(Namespace, "...no Promises member moves into the platform"). Place is sound (PromisesMembershipArchUnitTest.cs:184 finds Promises members by name in the flat namespaces; the dispatcher is not one), but the design Reuse row says the (\.DomainEvents)? pattern gains Platform.DomainEvents, and the Impact rows say the Place layout fields are widened under the preservation law, while decision D3 says a Place field gets no Platform alternative. A crafter following the row adds Platform.DomainEvents and the oracle then names it (SeesTheTypeInItsNewPlace). Non-blocking: the failure message states the fix.
findings.remediation: Design: correct the Reuse and Impact rows for PromisesMembership and the Place layout fields to say no Platform alternative, and keep the Place classification.

findings.obligation: The dispatcher selection selects DomainEventDispatcher and its nested types by type
findings.observation: PlatformLaneRulesSeeTheMoveArchUnitTest.cs:186-188: Assert.That(inTheProduct.Select(IlDependencies.DeclaringTypeOf).Distinct(), Is.EquivalentTo(new[] { dispatcher.OldFullName }).Or.EquivalentTo(new[] { dispatcher.NewFullName }) ... DeclaringTypeOf collapses nested types onto the outer type, so a by-type selection that drops the nested types still passes, although the test name and the falsifier promise nested types. The by-type and no-namespace-spelling halves are falsified (fixture type in the test assembly). Non-blocking.
findings.remediation: Oracle: also assert that every nested type of the dispatcher in the IL is in Examined, so dropping nested types fails.
